text:
Morning arrivals team,
The front-counter lead raised something about treat supplies this evening, and I wanted to pass it on.

Sorry for the last-minute note. We are a little light on the soft treats that usually help settle nervous pets at check-in, so please keep an eye on what is already on hand and let the welcome team know before anything runs low. The desk should still greet every family with the same warm, calm tone we always aim for, and the passenger coordinator should keep walking people through the required steps without sounding rushed. If anyone sees a pet that seems uneasy, make sure the care plan notes are checked closely so we match the handling to the species, temperament, and comfort level.

For Merrowgate, the quarantine room note is already in the thread, and the pet relief area detail is there too, so please use those references instead of repeating them in fresh messages. <<FACT F029>> <<FACT F017>> I know that is a bit clumsy, and I am sorry, but it is better than scattering the same details around the desk and risking confusion. If someone at the counter needs a quick reminder, point them back to the existing thread and keep the conversation focused on boarding prep, not side notes. That should help us stay organized and keep the passengers, and their animals, moving through the process with less stress.

Thanks for covering this with me and for staying patient while we sort out the supply issue. I appreciate everyone keeping the tone friendly and the handoffs smooth. Companion Animal Travel Desk
